protocol.primary_family: Five two-sided exact paired sign tests with Holm correction: evolved vs founder fitness, meals, collision rate, hazard fraction; evolved intact vs risk-hidden fitness.
protocol.decision: Adjusted p < .05 and paired mean-difference interval excluding zero in the same direction. Avoidance with foraging requires fitness_gain higher AND food_gain higher AND (collision_change lower OR hazard_change lower).
protocol.analysis_unit: Independent source seed; held-out repeats averaged within seed before inference.
protocol.intervals: Paired percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples, pointwise 95%. Sign ties <=1e-10.
protocol.sensing: Five radius-expanded barrier rays at -90,-45,0,45,90 degrees, range160; nearest hazard proximity,bearing,inside. Hidden risk inputs replace rays with1 and hazard inputs with0; original8 remain intact.
protocol.limitations: Fresh layouts from the same geometry family, not arbitrary mazes. Food sensing is non-occluded. Bodies use conservative radius-expanded rectangular barrier envelopes. Danger is charged at fixed-tick starting positions; default motion is1 pixel/tick. Penalized fitness mixes reward and costs; avoidance also requires improved meals and reduced living-time-normalized risk. No seasonal gate or static-training/drift control. No navigation/planning claim.
